text:
Maria (support): FYI — acme-corp reported their free-trial credits dropped from ~100k -> ~6k overnight. Customer says nothing interactive ran. Can we triage? @Jon (eng-ml) @Ria (billing)
Jon (eng-ml): Can you DM the acct id + exact timeframe? Any scheduled jobs on their org? Embeddings/rerank or plain generate?
Maria (support): Account acct_01F4XH, window 00:00–06:30 UTC. They run a nightly vector sync job (internal name `vec-sync`) that batches 10k docs into embeddings.batch. They also have a rerank job but it's smaller. Logs show a flurry of errors around 03:10–03:40.
Jon (eng-ml): Hypothesis: vec-sync got transient 5xx/429s and the client retrier spun up lots of attempts. If each retry created a new request without idempotency, each attempt could be charged separately. Can you paste a small log snippet?
Oliver (oncall): Seeing the logs for ingest-worker-7 around 03:12 UTC:
```
2026-02-28T03:12:11Z ingest-worker-7 req=7f3e2a path=/v1/embeddings.batch status=503 attempt=1 idempotency_key=none
2026-02-28T03:12:14Z ingest-worker-7 req=7f3e2a path=/v1/embeddings.batch status=503 attempt=2 idempotency_key=none
2026-02-28T03:12:20Z ingest-worker-7 req=7f3e2a path=/v1/embeddings.batch status=200 attempt=3 idempotency_key=none tokens=12000
```
Also many other requests with different local request ids but same document batch ids.
Maria (support): Customer says they used promo TRIAL-2026; starting balance 100k credits at 00:00. By 03:45 they were at ~6k. Billing snapshot shows ~94k consumed by repeated /embeddings.batch and some /rerank.create calls.
Ria (billing): I can see thousands of micro-charges for embeddings.batch between 03:10–03:50. Preliminary: each retry was billed. We need to confirm whether our server treats retries as distinct billable calls when idempotency header is missing.
Jon (eng-ml): We recently rolled a change to the ingest library on Feb 20 that toggled idempotency headers off for batch endpoints to simplify client logic. If true, retries would not dedupe. That would match this pattern.
deploy-bot: Deploy v2.14.1 -> ingest-workers rolled at 2026-02-20T23:50Z (changelog: "disable idempotency for batch endpoints to fix intermittent 409s").
Jon (eng-ml): That explains it. Plan: revert the idempotency regression on ingest-workers immediately; add server-side protection to dedupe identical batch ids; add metric alert for sudden credit depletion.
Ria (billing): We can issue a manual credit for the overage and top-up the trial back to 100k pending root-cause. Need written consent from the customer to adjust their promo balance. Estimate overcharged ~90k credits; exact amount after we reconcile.
Maria (support): I told the customer we're investigating and will credit any erroneous consumption. They asked for ETA and mitigation — gave 2hr ETA. I'll follow up with the consent request.
Jon (eng-ml): Action items: (1) rollback ingest-worker idempotency change (eng-oncall), (2) create server-side dedupe within 24h (eng-ml), (3) billing credit workflow (billing). I'll start rollback now.
Oliver (oncall): Rolling back patch to restore idempotency header and redeploying ingest-workers. Will report back when done.
Ria (billing): I'll prepare a one-time manual credit for TRIAL-2026 and the account acct_01F4XH. Will DM to confirm.
Maria (support): Thanks all — keeping customer updated.
